newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sears de Mexico up sharply on Carso buy.
newsitem.headline: Sears de Mexico up sharply on Carso buy.

text.p: Shares of Sears Roebuck de Mexico SA de CV rose sharply in the opening minutes of trade Wednesday following news that Mexican holding company Grupo Carso SA de CV would buy a 60 percent stake in the Mexican retailer from Sears Roebuck and Co, traders said.
Sears de Mexico B1 shares soared 2.10 pesos to 17.10 pesos in an otherwise dull market.
Sears de Mexico shares rose sharply on Monday and Tuesday amid widespread rumors about the Carso deal.
Sears said Carso would buy the stake at $2.2889 per share. Traders said the price was higher than Tuesday's closing Sears de Mexico price of 14.90 pesos.

"The purchase price explains why the share price is gaining; it is equivalent to about 18 pesos. But the stock is not very liquid so you might not be able to sell at that price," a floor trader in Mexico City said.

"The deal will have the most impact on the buyers, Carso, but first we need to analyze how they intend to pay for the deal and how compatible this new business line will be for Carso," the trader said.
Sears de Mexico shares headed the prominent gainers' list on the Mexican Stock Exchange, with Grupo Carso A1 shares in third place after climbing 40 centavos to 45.20 pesos.
